name: Mini-ofrenda competition
title: Mini-ofrenda competition
steps: Build a small ofrenda (shoebox size or smaller) for a person, pet, or figure you want to remember.
Include at least 4 traditional elements and label them in Spanish: las velas, las flores de cempasúchil, el pan de muerto, el papel picado, las fotos.
Add a card in Spanish: who it honors and why (3–5 sentences).
deliverable: Bring your mini-ofrenda to the event on Nov 4 for the competition. Can't attend? Submit a photo of it with your card.
submit: Where and when to submit is posted in D2L.
